---
name: Feature Request / Özellik İsteği
about: Propose a new feature or architectural improvement for LaundroQR
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem Statement / Çözülen Problem
Describe the resident or dormitory administrator pain point this feature addresses.

## Proposed Solution / Önerilen Çözüm
Describe the user flow, UI behavior, and backend/RLS requirements.

## Security & Multi-Tenant Impact / Güvenlik Etkisi
- Does this require new PostgreSQL tables or RLS policies?
- Does this affect machine state transitions (`available`, `in_use`, `cycle_complete`, `out_of_service`)?

## Alternatives Considered / Değerlendirilen Alternatifler
Any alternative approaches you considered.
